header: Using service-linked roles for Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Amazon OpenSearch Service uses AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) service-linked roles.
A service-linked role is a unique type of IAM role that is linked directly to OpenSearch Service.
Service-linked roles are predeﬁned by OpenSearch Service and include all the permissions that the
service requires to call other AWS services on your behalf.
A service-linked role makes setting up OpenSearch Service easier because you don’t have to
manually add the necessary permissions. OpenSearch Service deﬁnes the permissions of its service-
linked roles, and unless deﬁned otherwise, only OpenSearch Service can assume its roles. The
deﬁned permissions include the trust policy and the permissions policy, and that permissions policy
cannot be attached to any other IAM entity. For updates to service-linked roles and permissions
policies, see Document history for Amazon OpenSearch Service.
